title: T12 · Blog
description: The blog, its categories and its authors. Their header and their posts are rendered by the theme; the blocks after the posts are those of the options page archive-posts (Posts › Archive), not of the page for posts. Example: /blog/.

sections.label: Listing header
sections.note: The title of the page for posts, the name of the category or of the author in H1; the text field of the options page archive-posts, or the biography of the author; then the categories as filters.

sections.label: Post grid
sections.note: The posts of the archive, as many per page as set in Settings › Reading.

sections.label: Signup form
sections.note: In the blocks of the options page archive-posts, which also close every post.
